title: NASCAR Race Leaderboard
description: Configure live NASCAR race and leaderboard display.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the NASCAR race display.

show_oreilly_series.description: Show NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series sessions.

show_truck_series.description: Show NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series sessions.

display_mode.description: Auto shows the favorite driver when configured, otherwise the leaderboard.

favorite_cup_driver.description: Favorite Cup Series driver. Match by car number, NASCAR driver id, or part of the driver's name.

favorite_oreilly_driver.description: Favorite O'Reilly Auto Parts Series driver. Match by car number, NASCAR driver id, or part of the driver's name.

favorite_truck_driver.description: Favorite Craftsman Truck Series driver. Match by truck number, NASCAR driver id, or part of the driver's name.

leaderboard_limit.description: Number of leaderboard positions to rotate through.

show_lap_info.description: Show current lap and total laps when available.

show_delta.description: Show each driver's gap to the leader when NASCAR provides it.

live_priority.description: Let live NASCAR sessions temporarily take priority in the display rotation.

live_update_interval.description: Update interval in seconds while a selected NASCAR session is live.

idle_update_interval.description: Update interval in seconds when no selected NASCAR session is live.

schedule_cache_seconds.description: How long to cache NASCAR season schedules, in seconds.

event_logo_url_template.description: Optional event logo URL template. Supports {race_id}, {series_id}, and {year}; leave blank to use a logo URL from the schedule or a generated event badge.
